[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended using white quinoa or tri-color quinoa for the recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that white quinoa has a neutral taste and lighter texture, while tri-color quinoa offers a nuttier flavor and visual appeal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised rinsing quinoa before cooking to remove saponin, which can give it a bitter taste.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided storage tips for leftover quinoa, including refrigeration and freezing methods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended using a pot on the stovetop for cooking quinoa for better texture and control.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed method for cooking black beans, including sautéing onions and garlic, adding spices, and cooking until tender.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to add diced bell peppers to the black bean mixture for extra flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided several suggestions for avocado preparation for the Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl: diced avocado, mashed avocado, avocado slices, and guacamole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested adding lime juice to mashed avocado to prevent browning and enhance flavor.
